parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: The rotation blade of the knife is made of stainless steel, forming the sharp cutting edge of the object.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for cutting, slicing, or piercing materials. It rotates or folds into the base body for safety and portability.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around a pivot point to fold into or extend out from the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the knife is made of aluminum alloy, serving as the handle and housing for the folding blade.
parts.Functional_description: It provides grip and control during use, and houses the pivot mechanism that allows the blade to fold in and out.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the blade rotates relative to it.
